comment: Synthetic-test fixture. generator == 'synthetic_test' is a non-placeholder, non-real marker used to exercise the dm2_v2_hud_widget_assets PARTIAL/COMPLETE gate paths without shipping real PBR art. The 1x1 PNG tiles are NOT copyrighted DM2 artwork; they are tiny procedural tiles tagged synthetic-test-fixture via PNG tEXt chunk. This example exists ONLY so CTest can install the manifest into a scratch dir, observe the gate promote from PLACEHOLDER to PARTIAL/COMPLETE, and tear it down. It is NOT intended to be installed at the real ~/.firestaff/assets/dm2/hud/ location. The DM2 V2 HUD widget runtime contract is unchanged: real-art promotion requires operator-installed PBR art with a generator that is neither 'placeholder' nor 'synthetic_test', plus on-disk source_file entries. The runtime pixel decode for REAL slots is the documented replacement site for the 1-pixel anchor stamp (see dm2_v2_hud_runtime_render_with_assets).
